purpose: Structured rich target-language family-member profiles for the current Tier 1 Full Curriculum and Tier 2 Selective Lessons sets. Tier 3 Read + Games languages use the separate game-vocabulary core and must not inherit a fabricated culture profile.

record_contract.target_explainer_en: Canonical English editorial explanation of the target language's kinship pattern. Other support-language renderings should localize structured facts/templates rather than create independent pair-specific linguistic truth.
record_contract.distinctions: Only dimensions that materially affect beginner word choice. Absence from the array is not a claim that the language can never express the distinction.
record_contract.core_terms: Representative beginner terms with the distinctions needed for safe teaching. This is not an exhaustive kinship dictionary.
record_contract.cultural_note_en: Usage/culture caution. Do not turn community tendencies into claims about every family or speaker.
record_contract.examples: Short beginner-safe examples that illustrate the profile's actual distinctions.
record_contract.source_refs: Language-specific research provenance. Candidate records remain machine-created until reviewed.
